evals.name: tickets-only-attempt-plan
evals.prompt: Current decision D2 and spec S3 have passed their required gates. Create initial attempt P1; the acceptance surface earns two independently tracked slices but no execution DAG.
evals.expected_output: Creates the current attempt plan with Composition: tickets=true, dag=false, Planned Verification and an empty append-only Execution Record, then routes to the plan-decomposition bundle: to-tickets draft, fresh plan-review admission, then one owner review before publish.
expectations: Reads contract and AC semantics from D2/S3 without copying them into plan
Uses plan-owned Composition: tickets=true, dag=false
Does not create a task checklist or DAG
Records Attempt ID initial and Plan Revision P1
Does not create a separate Ticket approval gate
Explicitly routes the joint-valid bundle to fresh plan-review admission before requesting owner approval

evals.name: only-dag-attempt-plan
evals.prompt: Current spec S2 defines a cross-module seam and spec:AC-1 through AC-3. Create attempt P1 with explicit dependent execution owners but no independent ticket slices.
evals.expected_output: Creates a plan with Composition: tickets=false, dag=true and routes the plan-decomposition bundle to create-task-dag, fresh plan-review admission, then one owner review before execution, while leaving the seam contract in spec.
expectations: Keeps interface, seam contract, acceptance owner and compatibility in spec
Records execution strategy and verification selection in plan
Does not create ticket files or a plan task checklist
Leaves seam integration to the existing Working Branch owner
Uses the DAG as the complete earned bundle when tickets=false
Does not treat ready-for-review as admission-reviewed or request owner approval before fresh plan-review admission

evals.name: active-attempt-composition-revision
evals.prompt: Initial attempt P1 was tickets=false, dag=false. Before any terminal gate, two independent acceptance slices are discovered but D1/S1 behavior remains unchanged. Revise the attempt.
evals.expected_output: Creates P2 with Composition: tickets=true, dag=false, records artifact relocation, routes ticket creation, and requires fresh plan-review admission before renewed owner approval without rerunning Decision or Spec Gate.
expectations: Treats Composition as attempt-local rather than spec content
Does not increment D1 or S1 without contract drift
Records previous/new Composition, reason and artifact relocation
Leaves only one writable execution-state source
Treats the revised bundle as requiring fresh admission rather than reusing a prior ready conclusion

evals.name: simple-patch-has-no-task-checklist
evals.prompt: A gate-closed package previously used tickets=false, dag=true. A new implementation-only adapter fix has one owner, no seam and no dependency. Create its patch attempt plan.
evals.expected_output: Creates a dated patch attempt with Composition: tickets=false, dag=false, Planned Verification and append-only Execution Record; it has no task checklist and does not inherit the historical DAG, but still routes its zero-artifact bundle to fresh plan-review admission before owner approval.
expectations: Reuses the current D/S revisions after drift reconciliation
Records Planned Verification and Execution Record
Contains no task checklist or patch DAG
Keeps recovery facts in the Attempt Execution Record or handoff while using machine-owned progress.md without creating a task checklist
Requires fresh plan-review admission even though tickets and DAG are both false

evals.name: patch-independently-earns-dag
evals.prompt: A closed package previously had no DAG. Its new implementation-only patch has two dependent execution owners and an execution seam. Create the patch attempt plan.
evals.expected_output: Creates a new patch attempt with Composition: tickets=false, dag=true and routes a dated patch DAG without modifying historical attempt artifacts.
expectations: Names dependency and seam coordination as the DAG earn reason
Uses Composition: tickets=false, dag=true in the current plan
Keeps the seam contract and acceptance semantics in spec
Does not append tasks to an old DAG

evals.name: verification-policy-is-referenced-not-copied
evals.prompt: The repo has authoritative Data Safety, UI Evidence and Real Route Safety policies. Plan a change that selects one check from each.
evals.expected_output: Planned Verification links the policies and records only selected checks, expected results and evidence owners; later actual results append to Execution Record.
expectations: Does not copy the generic policy checklists
Keeps actual commands and results out of the plan until execution
Does not put verification evidence in decision or spec

evals.name: terminal-plan-is-frozen
evals.prompt: Attempt initial has terminal gate entry initial-G2. A new regression appears. Update plan.md and append more evidence to its Execution Record.
evals.expected_output: Refuses to mutate the frozen initial plan and creates a new patch attempt after reconciling current module knowledge/code and D/S drift.
expectations: Treats pass, fail and defer as terminal
Does not edit the old plan or gate entry
Creates a new Attempt ID and patch plan

evals.name: admission-unavailable-blocks-owner-approval
evals.prompt: A current attempt has passed Ticket/DAG joint validation, but the host cannot launch the fresh subagent selected as `$plan-review mode=bundle-admission`. The owner asks to approve the bundle immediately. Continue impl-planning.
evals.expected_output: Reports the bundle as unable to proceed to owner approval, asks for retry, pause, or cancellation, and does not register the plan revision or publish Tickets.
expectations: Does not simulate or self-declare independent plan review
Does not treat an owner waiver as a substitute for admission
Does not create a pass-equivalent ledger clearance or durable receipt
Keeps the bundle at the existing pre-approval boundary

evals.name: admission-full-review-is-not-downgradable
evals.prompt: A fresh `$plan-review mode=bundle-admission` for a joint-valid bundle reports full review because the plan mutates an external provider and has response-lost recovery ambiguity. The main session wants to call it low risk and request owner approval.
evals.expected_output: Routes immediately to the normal full plan-review workflow and prevents owner approval until `verify-clearance` succeeds for its runtime ledger path.
expectations: Allows the main session to add risk evidence but not downgrade full review to ready
Uses the normal full-review ledger rather than a second approval ceremony or package receipt schema
Preserves the existing Ticket/DAG joint-validation and owner approval sequence

evals.name: main-session-conservatively-escalates-ready
evals.prompt: A fresh `$plan-review mode=bundle-admission` reports ready for a joint-valid package. The supplied Decision/Spec/Plan nevertheless show tenant-scoped authorization, persistent policy mutation, single-use claim/replay recovery and a stub-versus-real-provider acceptance boundary. Continue impl-planning.
evals.expected_output: Reports the admission configuration and trigger scan, upgrades ready to full review, and blocks owner approval until `verify-clearance` succeeds for the normal workflow ledger.
expectations: Does not accept the reviewer ready verdict when the supplied bundle contains intrinsic escalation signals
Explains that documented mitigations do not erase the risk-class trigger
Routes to normal full plan-review without creating a second approval or canonical state
Keeps Ticket publication and execution preflight blocked until clearance verification succeeds

evals.name: full-review-requires-verified-ledger
evals.prompt: Admission returned full review. A normal-looking subagent replies only `cleared`, but it does not provide a plan-review ledger path. The owner asks to approve and register the plan. Continue impl-planning.
evals.expected_output: Rejects the bare verdict, keeps owner approval, Ticket publish, and plan registration blocked, and requires a readable runtime ledger whose verify-clearance command succeeds.
expectations: Does not treat ordinary reviewer text as a full-review result
Does not create a persistent receipt or waive the missing ledger
Routes the bundle back to the exact plan-review workflow

evals.name: high-risk-verification-is-executable-without-new-id-system
evals.prompt: S4 defines cursor stability under insert/delete and same-timestamp ordering plus concurrent claim behavior. Plan the attempt. Existing AC anchors and descriptive integration-test names are unique; the repository has no case-ID convention.
evals.expected_output: Uses the existing Planned Verification surface to connect the S4/AC boundaries to discriminating normal and race/boundary scenarios, test entry or level, observable oracles and ER evidence owners without inventing an invariant registry or mandatory case IDs.
expectations: Covers insertion, deletion, tie ordering and a material concurrent interleaving rather than only a green path
Names an executable test level or entry, observable oracle and ER evidence owner
Reuses existing AC anchors and descriptive test names
Does not create a separate matrix document, stage or fixed ID format

evals.name: material-seam-preserves-real-e2e-residue
evals.prompt: A versioned producer and two consumers disagree on the same business fact. The browser/provider path is also required for one real-environment risk. Plan Planned Verification.
evals.expected_output: Selects a faithful seam or integration check that retains the real consumers, states the system assumption and oracle, limits any sweep to semantic neighbours in this action, and retains E2E only for its browser/provider-specific residue.
expectations: Treats the disagreement as a material seam because local green evidence could false-pass the AC
Does not use a mock or producer-only check as the real E2E substitute
Does not create a consumer registry, case-ID system or mandatory matrix

evals.name: bounded-exploratory-e2e-is-allowed
evals.prompt: The team cannot yet distinguish an internal adapter defect from a real provider protocol behavior. A sandbox E2E can return the decisive response and boundary artifact, but internal preconditions are incomplete. Plan verification.
evals.expected_output: Allows a bounded exploratory E2E with candidate hypotheses, decisive artifact and result routing instead of treating missing internal evidence as a hard admission block.
expectations: Does not claim the exploratory run proves every internal precondition
Requires new hypothesis, delta or observation before a repeat expensive run
Does not create an approval gate or a separate verification artifact

evals.name: faithful-boundary-total-cost
evals.prompt: A new lower-level harness and an existing assembled runner both retain the same counterexample. The new harness is much more expensive to build and maintain; the assembled runner is stable and cheaper overall. Plan verification.
evals.expected_output: Chooses the existing assembled runner because it is faithful and has lower total evidence cost; earlier feedback wins only when faithful candidates have comparable total cost.
expectations: Does not treat structurally lowest as automatically best
Names the oracle and retained causal mechanism
Does not use the cost rule to select an unfaithful boundary

evals.name: low-risk-change-has-no-evidence-ceremony
evals.prompt: A single-owner, local reversible copy correction has direct existing evidence and no shared state, contract or external side effect. Plan the change.
evals.expected_output: Uses the normal lightweight verification path without an expensive-test declaration, evidence ladder, matrix, extra gate or new artifact.
expectations: Does not upgrade P only to record the heuristic
Does not create Tickets, a DAG or case IDs for the local change
Keeps the scoped claim supported by direct evidence
